dialogues.speaker: Observe the Stone Chair
dialogues.text: (There are three stone chairs around the stone table, and each one has a line of text engraved on it...)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the Stone Chair
dialogues.text: (There is a wine jar in front of the chair on the south-west side. Engraved on this chair is: "Here sits Retainer.")

dialogues.speaker: Observe the Stone Chair
dialogues.text: (There is a bowl and a pair of chopsticks in front of the chair on the north side. Engraved on this chair is: "Here sits Guizhong.")

dialogues.speaker: Observe the Stone Chair
dialogues.text: (There is nothing on the table in front of the chair on the south-east side. Engraved on this chair is: "Here sits Rex.")
